pilot_selection_rationale: Per CR-BP-94-EXT-18 §3, the pilot must select representative entities from the actual repository after inventory. The 11 selected entities (1 L1 + 1 L2 + 4 L3 + 5 L4) form a coherent L1 -> L2 -> L3 -> L4 decomposition chain. The selection covers all 7 CR criteria: (a) at least one L2 BP; (b) relevant L3 Activities; (c) at least one L4 Task under a selected Activity; (d) relevant L1 ProcessGroup context; (e) at least one entity with strong existing documentation (the L2 BP has 18 fields and 3 identity.evidence_links); (f) at least one entity with incomplete or uncertain operational information (0 of 11 have metadata.authoring populated); (g) at least one entity with meaningful cross-catalogue references (the L2 BP has 1 relationships entry + 1 context[] entry + 3 evidence_links).
